message.content:
**Short answer:** Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. The city’s police department and the City of Atlanta’s online portal are the primary ways to report it. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Call | |------|------------|---------------------------| | **1. Identify the type of noise** | • Residential or commercial
• Daytime (8 a.m.–10 p.m.) vs. nighttime (10 p.m.–8 a.m.)
• Persistent vs. one‑off | – | | **2. Use the 311 Service** | • Call **311** (free from any phone) or dial **(404) 656‑3111** from a non‑Atlanta number. | Atlanta Police Department (APD) | | **3. Online Complaint Form** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website:
• Navigate to “Services” → “Noise Complaint” (or search “noise complaint” in the site search). | City of Atlanta | | **4. Contact the Police** | • If the noise is urgent (e.g., ongoing disturbance, potential safety issue), call **911**. | Atlanta Police Department | | **5. Follow up** | • After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it for any follow‑up. | – | ### Quick Links | Resource | Link | |----------|------| | City of Atlanta – Noise Complaint Form | | | Atlanta Police Department – 311 | | | Atlanta Police Department – Contact | | --- ## Why the City Handles Noise Complaints - **Noise Ordinance Enforcement**: The City of Atlanta’s noise ordinance (Title 9, Chapter 3 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets permissible noise levels and hours. Violations are typically enforced by the police. - **Council Oversight**: While the city council legislates the ordinance, the day‑to‑day enforcement is carried out by the police and the city’s administrative offices. If you feel the council should intervene (e.g., repeated violations by a business), you can bring the issue to your local council member’s office. --- ## Tips for a Successful Complaint 1. **Be Specific**: Include the address, time, and nature of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). 2. **Document**: If possible, record a short audio clip or note the exact times the noise occurs. 3. **Check the Ordinance**: Familiarize yourself with the city’s noise limits (e.g., 70 dB during daytime, 60 dB at night) to strengthen your case. 4. **Follow Up**: If the issue persists after the initial complaint, call 311 again with your reference number. --- ## Bottom Line - **Yes, you can report a noise complaint in Atlanta.** - Use the 311 system, the online portal, or the police department. - The city council’s role is primarily legislative; enforcement is handled by the police and city officials. If you need more detailed guidance on the ordinance itself or want to contact a specific council member, let me know!
